input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also modify /turn/ply.num and be signed by the moving piece's own key plus at least twelve other distinct Black agents' keys, and a commit that modifies /moves/pawn_d7.text or /moves/rook_h8.text (the recent greed and panic offenders) must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
